data.name: Strong Crab
data.detailed_description:
One Leg, One Journey, An Act of Kindness Remembered

Introduction:

In the world of crabs, a legend about "Frank" is whispered. He is a two-legged giant known for extending a helping hand to injured kin. Now, another wounded crab—you, with only one leg remaining—has heard this tale. Clinging to a final shred of hope, you decide to embark on a journey to find Frank.

The road ahead is long and arduous. With your single remaining leg, you press keys to move, hopping across uneven sands, painstakingly balancing on slippery rocks, and even venturing through uncharted giant gathering places, all while evading predators from the sky and water. Every leap requires courage; every fall could be your last.

The keyboard becomes your new limb.

Use it to aim and gather strength.

Use it to leap across sheer cliffs, turning peril into triumph.

Use it to command this fragile yet resilient body, vaulting over seemingly impossible chasms.

This world is fraught with danger, yet it is also dotted with traces of kindness left by other creatures. This quest to find Frank is not just about survival—it is a trial of faith and perseverance.

Can you guide him to the end?

This is a warm and funny physics-based platformer. The game's inspiration comes from the true story of a blogger named Frank who rescued an injured crab.

You will play as an unlucky crab who has lost several legs, embarking on a difficult journey to find Frank using only one remaining leg.

【Core Gameplay】

  • Precise Leaping: Use keyboard controls to maneuver the crab for movement, rotation, and charged jumps.

  • Unique Movement: Master the techniques of single-legged mobility, rotation, and jumping to navigate rugged paths.

  • Overcome Obstacles: Be wary of waterways, natural predators, and various complex terrains—your crab is incredibly vulnerable.
